description: This file defines a C# interface IStatsCollectorGrain within the namespace UnitTests.Stats. The interface extends from IGrainWithIntegerKey and declares two asynchronous methods: ReportStatsCalled and GetReportStatsCallCount.

classes.name: IStatsCollectorGrain
classes.description: An interface for a stats collector grain in Orleans, providing methods to report stats and retrieve call count.

methods.name: ReportStatsCalled
methods.description: Asynchronously reports that statistics have been called.

methods.name: GetReportStatsCallCount
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the number of times report stats has been called.
